summary: Verified both frontend fixes end-to-end on desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (390x844). FIX 2: Contact section has 0 forms, 0 inputs, 0 textareas. FIX 2b: All 4 info rows present with correct hrefs (instagram.com/tanmayvisuals.in, mailto:work.tanmay.in@gmail.com, tel:+919266553033, Delhi NCR text). Mobile parity confirmed — no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth==clientWidth==390), 6 services still Explore-free, 4 prompt tiles stacked, no form present.
critical_code_review_comments: Contact.jsx still imports TEST_IDS.contactWhatsapp from constants (good); constants.js retains legacy contactSubmit/contactName/contactBrand/contactPhone/contactMessage/contactSuccess/contactError test ids that are no longer used anywhere in the UI — safe to remove for cleanliness (non-blocking).

4 console errors observed on load are 'Failed to load resource: 403' — these correspond to <video> asset fetches in the Work section (expected per agent note about Chromium H.264 codec / hosted asset fallback). No JS runtime errors.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both fixes verified. Contact form fully removed (0 form/input/textarea inside #contact). All 4 prompt tiles are <button> elements that call window.open with tailored wa.me URLs — click was intercepted by overriding window.open in-page and reading window.__lastOpen. Services cards have grid-cols-[auto_1fr] (no third column) and no ArrowUpRight import. Intro curtain requires ~3s wait or sessionStorage.clear() + wait. Mobile viewport 390x844 has 0 horizontal overflow. Legacy TEST_IDS in constants.js (contactSubmit etc.) are unused but harmless.
